'''Auddo Slokay''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]]. Stationed in a room south to the Medical Bay of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by rebel forces.
